definitions.gloss: way of sitting; sitting posture; manner of sitting
definitions.explanation: The manner or style in which a person sits. In Japanese culture, there are several distinct sitting styles, and the appropriate one depends on the setting and level of formality.

examples.japanese: {座|すわ}り{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{痛|いた}める→痛める：13613_itameru⟧。
examples.english: If your sitting posture is bad, you'll hurt your back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧{座|すわ}り{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がけている→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧。
examples.english: I try to maintain proper sitting posture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{和室|わしつ}→和室：10437_washitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{座|すわ}り{方|かた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦マナー→マナー：11139_manaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{正座|せいざ}→正座：10552_seiza⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{正式|せいしき}→正式：03376_seishiki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: There are manners for how to sit in a Japanese-style room, and seiza is considered the formal way.

notes:
Compound of {座|すわ}り (sitting, from ⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧) and ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ (way, method). The ⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧ suffix is productive and attaches to verb stems to mean "way of doing."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{正|ただ}しい→正しい：00893_tadashii⟧{座|すわ}り{方|かた}: correct sitting posture
- {座|すわ}り{方|かた}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: poor sitting posture
- {座|すわ}り{方|かた}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直|なお}す: to fix one's sitting posture
- ⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{座|すわ}り{方|かた}: how to sit in a chair

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese culture distinguishes several sitting styles:
- ⟦{正座|せいざ}→正座：10552_seiza⟧: kneeling with legs folded underneath — the most formal
- {胡座|あぐら}: cross-legged — casual, traditionally masculine
- {横座|よこずわ}り: sitting with legs to one side — traditionally feminine
- {体育座|たいいくずわ}り: sitting with knees up and arms around them — used in school gymnasiums
